canonical_rationale: Git stores this artifact with text eol=lf; LF is the canonical representation on Linux checkouts. The CRLF hash is preserved as the original freeze evidence and remains verifiable byte-for-byte.

migration.reason: S02-CP08-05R: Git (text eol=lf) materialises the LF form of the frozen YAML while the original sidecar pinned the CRLF freeze. Both representations of the unchanged v1.0.0 content are now recorded.
migration.note: No rule, value or comment of the frozen protocol was modified: the two hashes differ exclusively in line-ending encoding.
